notes: Terrain is modelled to 50 km around the site; ground beyond that is not included.
Shadow edges are resolution-limited: a 20 m elevation post cannot resolve a boulder, so the lit/dark boundary is soft at the scale of the terrain model.
The longest night and the longest blackout touch an edge of the window, so the window -- not the terrain -- ended them. The stretch continues beyond the window and the figure is a lower bound.
